Generic.Int64.name: Generic.Int64
Generic.Int64.description: Signed 64-bit integer; range bounded by JavaScript's safe-integer ceiling.

Generic.JSON.name: Generic.JSON
Generic.JSON.description: Any valid JSON value: object, array, primitive, or null

Identity.UUID.name: Identity.UUID
Identity.UUID.description: UUID v4 with automatic base62 encoding for client-facing APIs

Temporal.DateTime.name: Temporal.DateTime
Temporal.DateTime.description: ISO8601 datetime string. Epoch wire values keep this scalar and declare x-temporal-format (unix, unix_millis, unix_micros, unix_nanos) on the property; the unit is never guessed from digit count.

Checkout.name: Checkout
Checkout.comment:
A checkout that holds its lines and its gift wrap while it waits for
payment (D70, D103's step 4): entering held takes every item or none,
through the contract Supply each Inventory implements; placed commits
them, expired and cancelled let them go, and returned puts the units
back.

fields.name: holdsState
fields.description: The least advanced state of the items: none before any is asked, then pending, held, committed, released or returned. A rule hears it turn committed.

fields.name: holdsTotal
fields.description: The sum of the priced items' unit prices times their quantities, as { amount, currency }: an item without a price adds nothing, and with none priced it is { amount: 0, currency: null }. Null only when the priced items' currencies differ or the sum passes what a JSON number holds exactly.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The state the instance is in.

fields.name: statusEnteredAt
fields.description: When the status last changed, in epoch milliseconds: the create's time, then each transition's. Absent on an instance created before Workflow kept it, until its next transition.

CheckoutHoldsItems.name: CheckoutHoldsItems
CheckoutHoldsItems.comment: On a table, each item the claim has taken, keyed by its hold and index: the supply it names, what it asks, its state and the unit price the supply held it at, and the Workflow entry it was taken at. An item its fields ask that it has not taken is no row; the items field shows it pending.

fields.name: checkout
fields.description: The Checkout row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: key
fields.description: The hold's name and the item's index, joined by /.

fields.name: hold
fields.description: The hold's name.

fields.name: item
fields.description: The item's index in its hold.

fields.name: supplySchema
fields.description: The supply's type.

fields.name: supplyId
fields.description: The supply's key.

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: The units of counted supply it asks.

fields.name: startMs
fields.description: When the time it asks starts, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: endMs
fields.description: When the time it asks ends, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: state
fields.description: pending, held, committed, released or returned.

fields.name: unitPrice
fields.description: The unit price the supply held it at, in the currency's minor units.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: The unit price's currency.

fields.name: takenAt
fields.description: The Workflow's enteredAt at the take, which tells a later entry of a takeOn state from this one.

Inventory.name: Inventory
Inventory.comment:
What a shop sells (D70, D103's step 4): units on hand and units claims
hold, counted by Stock, each change a movement of its ledger. A caller
holding stock.adjust receives, adjusts and counts it; its price, in GBP
minor units, is what a line is held at; and it reads low at or below
its reorder level.

fields.name: stockOnHand
fields.description: The units on hand: received, adjusted and counted, less what claims committed, plus what they returned. Always the sum of the instance's movements.

fields.name: stockHeld
fields.description: The units claims hold and have neither committed nor released.

InventoryStockHolds.name: InventoryStockHolds
InventoryStockHolds.comment: On a table, the supply's record of each claim item it holds or held, keyed by the claim's type and key, the hold and the item's index: what the item asked, its state, which a call moves only forward, so a call made again changes nothing, and the price it was held at. A deleted claim's records retire under a key of their own: what it held is released, what it committed stays sold, and a claim created again with its key holds afresh.

fields.name: inventory
fields.description: The Inventory row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: record
fields.description: The claim's type, its key, the hold and the item's index, joined by /; a retired record's has # and a key of its own after it.

fields.name: holderSchema
fields.description: The claim's type.

fields.name: holderId
fields.description: The claim's key.

fields.name: hold
fields.description: The hold's name in the claim's Holds config.

fields.name: item
fields.description: The item's index in its hold.

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: The units the item asked.

fields.name: state
fields.description: held, committed, released or returned.

fields.name: unitPrice
fields.description: The unit price it was held at, in the currency's minor units.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: The unit price's currency.

fields.name: at
fields.description: When it last moved, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: retired
fields.description: Whether it is a deleted claim's.

InventoryStockMovements.name: InventoryStockMovements
InventoryStockMovements.comment: On a table, every change of what is on hand, append-only, keyed by its sequence from 1: its kind, its delta, what was on hand after it, its reason and reference, the claim and item it was for, who made it and when. onHand always equals the sum of the deltas.

fields.name: inventory
fields.description: The Inventory row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: seq
fields.description: The movement's sequence on the row, from 1, as decimal text.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: receive, adjust, count, commit or return.

fields.name: delta
fields.description: What it added to what is on hand, below 0 for what it took away.

fields.name: onHand
fields.description: What was on hand after it.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Why, as the caller gave it; absent for a claim's.

fields.name: reference
fields.description: A reference the caller gave, such as a delivery note's.

fields.name: holderSchema
fields.description: For a commit or a return, the claim's type.

fields.name: holderId
fields.description: For a commit or a return, the claim's key.

fields.name: hold
fields.description: For a commit or a return, the hold.

fields.name: item
fields.description: For a commit or a return, the item's index.

fields.name: actor
fields.description: The subject of the caller whose command made it.

fields.name: at
fields.description: When, in epoch milliseconds.

Line.name: Line
Line.comment: One line of a checkout: the inventory it takes and how many.
